g.text: Age-selective domestic migration and regional aging | 2022
All 47 prefectures and 51 U.S. state-level regions; equal-region descriptive correlations.
Rates: Japan, same-age Oct 1 population (rounded to 1,000); U.S., same-age current-residence ACS B07001 population.
U.S. bars: approximate 90% ratio MOEs including denominator uncertainty; hollow points: interval includes zero. Unknown covariances omitted.
Sources: Japan Internal Migration annual files + Population Estimates; U.S. ACS 1-year B07001/B07401. Registration events and survey residence changes differ.
Panels use separate scales. Labels: Tokyo/DC and each country/year's minimum and maximum young-adult rate. No pooled fit or causal interpretation.
